content.h2: What WordPress hosting with free migration means at DronaHost
content.answer: DronaHost is a managed WordPress hosting and web services company for businesses worldwide. Every plan includes the free migration of one website: we transfer it, ask your permission, then point your DNS. After that, we apply WordPress updates, run NGINX caching, take daily backups and fix WordPress problems in support tickets. You keep full control of your site.

content.h2: What changed for a store that moved to DronaHost
Questions about moving your WordPress site

items.q: What does the free migration include?
items.a: Every hosting plan includes the free move of one website. You share access to your current hosting, we transfer your files and database, and we ask your permission before your DNS changes. Your old site keeps running until then. The migration terms list what the move covers and what it does not.

items.q: Will my site go offline during the move?
items.a: No. We copy your site to DronaHost while your old site keeps serving visitors. Nothing changes for them until your DNS points to us. When the transfer is done, we ask your permission, and we only make the switch after you say yes. Your visitors keep using the old site the whole time.

items.q: Can I lose data when I move my site?
items.a: No data leaves your old host. We copy your files and database to DronaHost and leave the originals where they are, so a complete copy stays with your current host until the switch. You decide when the switch happens, because we ask your permission before your DNS changes.

items.q: Will my theme and plugins work after the move?
items.a: Yes, they move with your site, because we transfer the whole site to DronaHost: files, database, theme and plugins. If an error or a plugin conflict appears after the move, open a support ticket and we fix it. WordPress fixes are part of support on every plan.

items.q: Does the price go up when I renew?
items.a: No. You renew at the same price you started on, and that price has no end date. The pricing page shows each plan's signup price and renewal price together, so you can see both before you buy. Prices exclude tax. Customers in India pay GST at checkout.

items.q: How much does WordPress hosting cost?
items.a: Each plan shows its price on the plan cards on this page, billed monthly or yearly. Paying yearly costs less per month. The price you start on stays the same when you renew, with no end date, so there is no low first-year price that rises later. Prices exclude tax. Customers in India pay GST at checkout.

items.q: How often do you back up my site?
items.a: Every day. DronaHost takes two daily backups of your site: one local copy and one offsite copy. Each new backup replaces the one before it, so each one keeps only the latest copy. If you need older versions, keep your own copies as well. The backup policy explains how backups work.

We promise 99.99% uptime on every hosting plan, backed by service credits. If we miss that figure in a month, you can claim a credit on your bill. The SLA page defines how uptime is measured, what counts as downtime and how to claim a credit.

Email is not included with any hosting plan; business email with Google Workspace is a separate service. Support is by ticket and email only, with no live chat or phone. WordPress hosting does not include root access, SSH or WP-CLI; you manage your site from the control panel. Spam and adult websites are not allowed on DronaHost.

items.q: Can I run a WooCommerce store?
items.a: Yes. WooCommerce stores run on every plan. Pro is made for busy sites and small stores, and Scale for WooCommerce stores with heavy traffic, on dedicated resources. Each plan lists its sites, storage, memory and CPU, so you can match a plan to the size of your store. Compare the plans on the pricing page.
